exposure: maternal exposure to parabens (methylparaben, ethylparaben, propylparaben, butylparaben)
outcome: transfer of parabens through the placental barrier
offspring birth size (weight, height, head circumference, chest, hip, and arm circumference)
finding: Parabens were detected in amniotic fluid samples, and there was a strong/possible correlation between exposure of pregnant women to parabens and the birth size of newborns.
